Sprites and images

6 calls on gfx, generated from the firmware. Every one exists on the device exactly as written here.

Needs art files in the app package. Each one is a silent no-op when the app ships none.

gfx.image

gfx.image(name [, x, y [, scale]]) -> bool

needs asset files engine v2

Draw assets/images/{name}.vsp (a scene or background; engine v2). false when the image is missing. Integer scale (engine v14, 1..4) draws it nearest-neighbour scaled, the native-canvas path for backgrounds authored against the classic canvas.

#argument
1namerequired: image name only (no path, no extension)
2xoptional, default 0
3yoptional, default 0
4scaleoptional, default 1

gfx.map

gfx.map(cel_x, cel_y, ...)

stub

NOT IMPLEMENTED. A no-op that logs once per app run. Tilemaps were deferred because sprite loops cover what v1 apps need; the entry stays registered so an app that reaches for it gets nothing drawn rather than a nil-index crash.

gfx.shademap

gfx.shademap(level, t)

Register the palette remap texcol applies at shade level 1..7 (0 = no shade): t[i+1] is the index drawn for source index i. Missing entries keep the identity mapping. Don't map to 255, transparency is decided before the remap.

#argument
1levelrequired: shade level 1..7
2trequired

gfx.sprite

gfx.sprite(id, x, y [, flip "x"|"y"|"xy" [, scale]])

needs asset files engine v2

A cell of assets/sprites.vsp (engine v2, docs/07). No-op when the app ships no sheet. Integer scale (engine v14) draws the cell scale x bigger, the native-canvas path for classic-authored art; routed through the ssprite scaler.

#argument
1idrequired
2xoptional, default 0
3yoptional, default 0
4flipoptional, default ""
5scaleoptional, default 1

gfx.ssprite

gfx.ssprite(cell, x, y, w, h [, flip [, shade [, depth]]])

Sheet cell scaled to w x h. depth (world units) z-tests per pixel against the last gfx.terrain pass so billboards hide behind hills; omit for HUD and the player character. flip like gfx.sprite ("x"|"y"|"xy").

#argument
1cellrequired
2xrequired
3yrequired
4wrequired
5hrequired
6flipoptional, default ""
7shadeoptional, default 0
8depthoptional

gfx.texcol

gfx.texcol(x, yTop, h, cell, tx [, shade [, w]])

engine v3

One textured vertical column: texel column tx of sheet cell cell, scaled to h on-screen pixels starting at yTop (engine v3). Transparent texels skip, so billboards draw column-by-column. No-op when the app ships no sheet, like gfx.sprite.

#argument
1xrequired
2yToprequired
3hrequired
4cellrequired
5txrequired
6shadeoptional, default 0
7woptional, default 1
